CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

   B. Use Samson kills a Lion to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Samson kills a Lion has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Samson kills a Lion.

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
